profile_text.body:
IBM, founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY, is a publicly traded technology company (NYSE: IBM) that reported revenue of $67,535,000,000 for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025. The company's products page centers on IBM OpenPages, which it describes as a scalable, AI-powered governance, risk, and compliance platform available on any cloud or on-premises, offering modular components for risk management, compliance, audit, and model governance functions. The site notes that IDC recognized IBM as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment, and highlights a partnership with Citi to automate internal audit processes using AI and machine learning, which the company says saved thousands of manual hours.

IBM tracks three AI products in this space. IBM OpenPages with Watson is a full GRC platform incorporating AI-specific modules, risk assessment, regulatory mapping, and Watson AI automated documentation. IBM watsonx.governance covers AI lifecycle governance including model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation, with EU AI Act accelerators, and was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. IBM watsonx is described as an enterprise AI platform that is model-agnostic and includes capabilities for agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection. The site also notes an OpenPages MCP Server intended to allow AI agents to create, query, and update GRC objects within governed automation frameworks.

The held facts associate IBM with 321 items of legal exposure in New York, though no specific cases are recorded. IBM's SEC CIK is 0000051143, consistent with its long-standing status as a public company filing with the SEC.
